item.title: Megan Moroney’s Schottenstein Center Setlist: Every Song from Opening Night Of Her ‘Cloud 9’ Tour in Columbus, Ohio
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news in music. Today, we're shining the spotlight on country music star Megan Moroney.
[Short music transition]
Host: It's been an incredible few years for Megan, with hits like "Tennessee Orange" and "Beautiful Things" catapulting her to the top of the country music scene. Her latest album, Cloud 9, debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 chart, a feat no female country artist has achieved since 2024.
[Short music transition]
Host: And the accolades keep coming - Megan received nine nominations for the 2026 Academy of Country Music Awards, the most for any artist in a single year. But that's not all, she's also kicked off her first arena headlining tour with a sold-out show in Columbus, Ohio.
[Short music transition]
Host: The high-energy show featured a mix of songs from all her albums, with a focus on Cloud 9. And, in a fun surprise, she even threw in a fan favorite from her 2022 EP, "Hair Salon".
[Short music transition]
Host: The tour is just getting started, with upcoming stops in Indianapolis, Chicago, and Nashville, before heading to Europe. We can't wait to see what's next for this rising star.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode.
